pages.text: Flat gates placed on the floor. The output faces the direction you look in when placing. Inputs: $(l)L$() left, $(l)B$() back, $(l)R$() right. $(li)NOT: !B to front, left and right (side outputs switchable) $(li)Buffer: B to front, left and right (side outputs switchable) $(li)AND: L and B and R, B off by default

$(li)NAND: not (L and B and R), B off by default $(li)OR / NOR: L or B or R $(li)XOR / XNOR: L xor R $(br2)Right-click any gate: description, live inputs/outputs and options - switch inputs off (grey plug).
